newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end down on govt spokesman's rate remarks.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end down on govt spokesman's rate remarks.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Wednesday's Tokyo session slightly lower.
The June ended down 0.04 at 124.90, after trading between 124.85 and 125.07. Turnover was 50,529 contracts.

Dealers liquidated long positions in the last half hour of trade following chief government spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama's remark that Japan should consider measures to deal with the adverse impact low interest rates have on people's incomes.
"Those players who were trying to trigger a short-squeeze above 125.00 liquidated longs on Kajiyama's remarks," said a brokerage house trader.
